relations.text: ROSA太陽電池アレイの最後の1組が、NASAのSpaceX CRS-35ミッションで国際宇宙ステーションへ打ち上げられる
relations.text_en: The fourth and final pair of Redwire's ROSA wings is launching to the International Space Station on NASA's SpaceX CRS-35 mission

source.label: RDW / Boeing — official relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: RDW / Boeing — official relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: RDW), a leader in space infrastructure for the next generation space economy, announced today that the fourth and final pair of its Roll-Out Solar Array (ROSA) wings for the International Space Station will be launching to the station onboard NASA’s SpaceX 35 th cargo resupply services mission (SpaceX CRS-35).
source.note: NASAの補給ミッションを通じた打ち上げです。
source.note_en: Launch is via a NASA resupply mission.

relations.text: Redwire子会社のSpaceMDが、SpaceXのStarfall宇宙船による飛行の契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Redwire's subsidiary SpaceMD signed a contract for a Starfall mission on SpaceX's spacecraft

source.label: Redwire の発表
source.quote: Space Microgravity Development LLC (SpaceMD), a wholly owned subsidiary of Redwire Corporation (NYSE:RDW) and venture company focused on leveraging the microgravity environment to create dynamic innovations, announced today that it has signed a contract for a Starfall mission. Starfall is SpaceX’s new spacecraft that enables affordable, routine access to a microgravity environment
source.note: 子会社SpaceMDによる契約で、飛行は2028年の計画です。
source.note_en: Contract signed by the subsidiary SpaceMD; the flight is planned for 2028.

relations.text: 2025年12月31日時点の負債総額8,840万ドルは、主にJPMorgan Credit Agreementに関するものである
relations.text_en: As of December 31, 2025, $88.4 million of total debt outstanding related primarily to the JPMorgan Credit Agreement

source.label: Redwire 10-K
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had $88.4 million of total debt outstanding primarily related to the JPMorgan Credit Agreement and up to $35.0 million of additional borrowing capacity under our revolving credit facility of the Adams Street Credit Agreement.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: Adams Street Credit Agreementの返済に、JPMorgan Credit Agreementの借入金が一部充てられた
relations.text_en: Proceeds from the JPMorgan Credit Agreement partly offset repayments under the Adams Street Credit Agreement

source.label: Redwire 10-K
source.quote: The change to net repayments of debt was driven primarily by the repayment of all outstanding principal balances of the term loans and revolving credit facility under the Adams Street Credit Agreement and the repayment of the Seller Note which is partially offset by proceeds from the JPMorgan Credit Agreement.

relations.text: Redwireは兼松と提携契約を結び、日本の宇宙産業の成長を後押しする
relations.text_en: Redwire signed a teaming agreement with Kanematsu to support the growth of Japan's space industry

source.label: Redwire の発表
source.quote: Redwire Corporation (NYSE: RDW), a global leader in aerospace and defense technology solutions, announced that it has signed a teaming agreement with Kanematsu Corporation (hereinafter “Kanematsu”). The collaboration combines Redwire’s advanced space technologies with Kanematsu’s extensive market expertise to support the growth of Japan’s space industry.

relations.text: RedwireはMoogのMETEOR衛星バスに組み込む太陽電池アレイ(ELSA)翼を、1,280万ドルで納入する契約を受注した
relations.text_en: Redwire was awarded a $12.8 million contract to deliver ELSA solar array wings to Moog for integration with its METEOR satellite bus

source.label: Redwire の発表
source.quote: today announced it has been awarded a $12.8 million contract to deliver Extensible Low-Profile Solar Array ( ELSA ) wings to Moog, Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B). The wings will be integrated with Moog’s METEOR satellite bus
